job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Atlas Agent Engine

details.about: MongoDB's developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is a globally distributed, multi-cloud database available across AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure. Atlas Agent Engine is a new agent development platform built on Atlas that lets enterprises build, deploy and govern AI agents in production on their real-time data, with execution, memory and governance in one foundation. This engineer helps build and scale the core of that platform.
duties: Build the developer CLI, SDKs and distributed systems that run agents reliably at scale: runtime, memory, retrieval, identity and governance layers
Work with research, product management, engineering and design to deliver the first version of the service and its evolution
Design, build and deliver well-tested core pieces of the platform
Help shape architecture, code reviews, development practices and developer experience
Mentor fellow engineers and own projects end to end
needs: Strong background building core components of high-scale compute and data distributed systems
5+ years building distributed systems and/or foundational cloud services at scale, and an interest in working with Go, Python and TypeScript
Proven success designing, writing, testing, debugging, performance tuning and maintaining distributed or highly concurrent systems in large, long-lived code bases
A track record of delivering complex projects in distributed systems or databases
Good verbal and written technical communication
nice: Experience with AI frameworks and tools, open standards such as MCP and A2A, multi-tenant security, and enterprise authentication and identity management
details.benefits: Base salary $126,000 – $264,000 a year in the U.S.; offers depend on skills, experience, qualifications and work location. Other benefits for eligible employees may include equity, the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks of fully paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, a 401(k) plan, mental health counseling and health benefits.
notes: Open to candidates in the United States under MongoDB's remote working model
Accommodations are available during the application and interview process
